text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—I was terrified, it was so close... 
But...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I beat... Tamamo-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Oooooooh!? City has taken down the mighty 
Tamamo Cross~~!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Amazing—I want to see an even more 
brilliant run from you next year!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Does that mean the results don't even 
matter?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Too bad about Tamamo Cross... but man, 
she's seriously strong!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Because she was a late bloomer, she's 
bound to be even stronger next year! Keep 
your eyes on Tamamo Cross in the Senior 
class!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Must be nice. To have people look only 
at how you run.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Even though I was the one who won. Even 
though I was... the stronger one.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Haha...—*sigh*.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...I never should have thought about 
running."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Because it's all—a waste of time.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: ... City...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: —Hey, you...! Are you messing with me?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I warned you, didn't I!? I told you not 
to run all weird like that, didn't I!?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...I wasn't. I actually beat you after 
all, senpai."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not what I meant literally!! 
You know that yourself, don't ya?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Tch...! Sulking like that, what are you, a 
brat...?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you have a reason to show some real 
guts...?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "...Hey, let me hear it one more time."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ――What are you running for anyway?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What do ya run for, anyway?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ... The answer to that is obvious.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Don't hang your head!! Look me dead in the 
eye!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Nghh!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...How boring. Forget it, I expected way 
too much from ya.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"After all, nothin' I say carries any 
weight since I'm the one who lost, 
huh...?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Why couldn't I say anything?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Whatever, who cares. I mean... there's 
no point anyway."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Trainer. It's fine already.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Even if I run... it's completely 
pointless after all."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No matter what kind of results I deliver, 
it won't change the way people look at me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If I show what I'm made of, I can change 
how people see me. That's why I worked 
hard. That's why I kept running.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
“All of that was nothing more than wishful 
thinking on my part, though.”

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Everyone only cares about the "pretty 
City". Nobody gives a damn about my 
running.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"So all my efforts up until now were 
completely useless... And they'll just 
keep being useless from now on."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...I don't care about anything anymore...

Gold City has become completely 
indifferent. Entering her in the Arima 
Kinen might have been the wrong move after 
all.

However, before I regretted it—there was 
one thing I absolutely had to confirm.
choice_data_list: Then do you want to stop running?

text_block_list.text:
She remained silent. That silence alone 
was more than enough.

"Right now, the tension just left her body 
after being on edge for so long. If so, 
then all I can do... is continue preparing 
the path for her to run."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...I'm getting changed. Get out—
choice_data_list:
Before that, let's decide on your next 
race.

Before that, let's decide on your next 
race.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...I already told you, there's no point 
in running."
choice_data_list:
I want to aim for the Spring Senior Triple 
Crown

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Wasn't even listening.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Annoying. Whatever, do what you want. 
You're the one handling the race 
registration anyway.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If you want them to run, just let them do 
whatever they want.
choice_data_list: Alright, first up is the Osaka Hai!
Alright, first up is the Osaka Hai!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You're seriously just gonna decide that on 
your own?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Anyway, I want to get changed, so get 
out.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I said get out...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Why are you doing this? I told you, 
there's no point—
